title: Return the Owner
goal: Return text created inside a function without creating a dangling reference.
hints: Look at what happens to title when make_header returns.
A reference cannot outlive local stack data. Return the owned string directly.
explanation: `title` is created inside `make_header` and dropped when the function returns. Returning `&title` or `title.as_str()` produces error `E0515` because the returned reference points to local memory that no longer exists. Returning `&str` or `&String` with `title` causes a type mismatch `E0308`. To pass the formatted text to the caller, set the return type to `String` and return `title` by value, transferring ownership.
